title: Sovereign Grassroots Currencies: A CBDC Architecture for Credit and Monetary Policy (Full Version)
summary: A Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) is central-bank money in digital form, held by the public. Leading designs have two limitations: conversion from bank deposits into CBDC can accelerate deposit flight, requiring safeguards, and the CBDC stays outside credit creation and monetary-policy operations.
